subtitle: Selected data & analytics work from my GitHub

projects.title: Multi-Source Marketing Analytics
projects.description: Unified marketing analytics workspace that consolidates multiple channels into a single attribution and channel-performance view - the kind of cross-source reporting I build day to day.

projects.title: Customer Churn Prediction
projects.description: Machine-learning model that flags at-risk customers from behavioural and transaction data, enabling targeted retention campaigns before customers leave.

projects.title: Online Payments Fraud Detection
projects.description: Classification model that detects fraudulent online-payment transactions using feature engineering and imbalanced-data techniques on a large transaction dataset.

projects.title: Grocery Retail Prediction & Recommendation
projects.description: Demand-prediction and product-recommendation engine for online grocery retail, modelling purchase patterns to lift basket size and repeat purchase.

projects.title: Enhanced Anomaly Detection System
projects.description: Automated anomaly-detection system that flags traffic and conversion irregularities in real time - the same alerting concept I productionised at PepsiCo.

projects.title: Data Science Salary Estimator
projects.description: End-to-end regression project - data collection, cleaning, EDA and modelling - that estimates data-science compensation from role, skills and location.
